chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said:

Regarding the woman who marries a domestic servant (slave), and he grows older with her, so his value increases or decreases, then he divorces her before consummating the marriage, he said: 'Upon her is half his value on the day he was handed over to her; the increase and the decrease are not considered.'
ai.seo_question: What is the dowry for a woman divorced before consummation if she married a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific calculation of mahr for a woman married to a male slave (waṣīf) who is divorced before consummation, establishing that the amount is fixed at half the slave's market value at the time of the contract. Notably, it excludes fluctuations in value due to aging or physical changes, reflecting the Shia juristic view that the 'half mahr' rule applies proportionally to the asset's worth at the time of the binding agreement rather than at the time of divorce. This ruling underscores the precision in Shia fiqh regarding variable assets and the protection of the woman's financial rights in such unique marital configurations.
